BEFORE YOU ENROL

A few practical questions.

Unsure whether it fits your work?
Ask Greg a question.

Can I use this to help a junior estimator?

Yes. The lessons, worksheets and worked examples give them a process to study and practise. Your shop still supplies job context, verified standards and review. Each purchase covers one learner; contact Greg about additional seats.

What happens after the first community year?

Continued community access is optional at US$29/month. The current offer says you receive an invitation and are charged only if you choose to subscribe. You keep your purchased training and downloads if you leave the community.

What software does V30 require?

Use desktop Microsoft Excel for the macro-enabled workbook, and confirm your company supports macros. The method and references can be used alongside existing spreadsheets or ERP. Automatic ERP integration is not included.

How does the guarantee work?

Email gregwsheldon@gmail.com within 30 days of initial enrolment with your enrolment name and email. Under the current offer, all amounts paid for the initial purchase are refunded and remaining instalments cancelled. No completed worksheets or proof of results are required. Refunds end access and the download licence, and downloaded copies must be deleted. The guarantee does not restart with instalments or apply to later community renewals.
